reviews.comment: He's a great professor if you love ento! He doesn't think his tests are hard, but they definitely aren't easy! I would say that unless you already have a background in ento, this is not an easy A course. However he provides a LOT of extra credit if you participate in class! definitely answer questions even if you think ur wrong, its worth it!
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you have never taken a taxonomy course then this will be tough. However, Bernal makes this class so much easier than other taxonomy courses. He is very passionate and really cares for his students. If you study and do your work you will do fine. Not an easy A course but not super hard either.

imo Bernal made this class way harder than necessary and would purposely trip you up on exams with obscure questions. overall it was interesting and I made a good grade because he gives A LOT of extra credit if you come to class and participate (like 10+%). lab quizzes are open note w extra credit on the lab project too. take another prof if u can!

His lectures are great; he clearly knows and loves what he's talking about. He wants you to succeed, but coming from someone with ENTO background, his exams are tough. Extra credit is given for participation and the lab project, and grades were adjusted up based on the highest class average for my class. PAY ATTENTION IN LECTURE PLS

Not a super difficult class but it will require a good amount of reviewing the slides to do well on exams. The exam questions are taken pretty much directly from the slides. There is extra credit provided for participating in class discussions as well as on the collection project.

Haven't finished the class yet.should make a BorC. The class isn't awful. Good professor. You have to memorize the scientific names for the bugs. other than that it is not hard at all. If I spent just a little more time studying I would have a higher grade in the class. Extra credit
lab exams are hard. Get taken off for spelling. ifUtry get AorB

Best teacher ive ever had. He always cares about his students and shows up prepared. He usually wears a louis belt with a pair if gucci shoes to compliment the drip. Best teacher and definitely the best dressed on campus.
He loves entomology but this is not an easy class. Luckily the lab saved me cause I got an A in that. Make sure to do the extra credit

I took the class because i heard it was easy but that was NOT TRUE. I never understood one single thing in that class because i'm not a visual learner. The amount of insects that you had to memorize and the type of species.. horrible. We also had to collect 20 different types of bugs within different species. Save yourself the Q drop

Provides PowerPoints for outside studying & goes more into depth in class. Class & lab align with lessons & provides insects for visual learners. Lab does require a lot of individual teaching. There are four exams, a couple of lab quizzes, some lab papers & a bug collection. Also gives optional lecture quizzes for extra credit points.

I didn't need this class, but he was a good professor. He gives a LOT of extra credit, so make sure to take advantage of that. For the lab, start collecting your insects EARLY! Attendance isn't mandatory, but does count as extra credit so def try going to class. Not an easy A.
Yea. Everything is pretty easy, but it just takes time to study all of the material for the test. No final. He does give extra credit assignments for tests and going to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT
